title: 8-Day Greece Tour: Athens, Meteora & Santorini
metaTitle: Meteora & Santorini Tour | 8 Days in Greece

summary:
The 8-Day Athens, Delphi, Meteora & Santorini Tour brings together Greece’s classical past, mountain landscapes and island life in a route that remains manageable within eight days. Begin at the Acropolis in Athens, then travel to Delphi to visit the Sanctuary of Apollo before continuing to Meteora and its centuries-old monasteries built high on natural rock pillars. Santorini comes last, giving you time to slow down and explore the caldera, villages and island independently.
This journey is offered from April to October, in line with the seasonal program. It includes selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, domestic flights, airport transfers and the sightseeing specified in the itinerary.

itinerary.title: Arrival to Athens
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Athens International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Half day Morning Athens City Tour
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Enjoy a half-day guided tour of Athens, including the Acropolis of Athens, Acropolis Museum, and Parthenon.
Continue past the Parliament, Tomb of the Unknown Soldier, Presidential Palace, Panathenaic Stadium, Temple of Olympian Zeus, and Arch of Hadrian. Afternoon at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Athens to Delphi then to Kalambaka
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Pick up from your hotel in Athens and depart for Delphi, passing through Thebes, Levadia, and the mountain village of Arachova. Visit the famous Archaeological Site of Delphi, then continue through the scenic towns of Central Greece to Kalambaka. Dinner and overnight in Kalambaka.

itinerary.title: Meteora Tour then to Athens
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel.
Visit Meteora and explore its famous monasteries built on towering rock formations. Enjoy breathtaking views and discover important religious treasures. Return to Athens through Trikala and Lamia, with a short stop at Thermopylae to see the King Leonidas Monument. Arrival in Athens in the evening. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Ferry to Santorini
itinerary.text:
Breakfast and check-out from the hotel. Transfer to the port for your ferry to Santorini.
Arrival and transfer to your hotel. Rest of the day at leisure. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Santorini at leisure
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a free day in Santorini to relax on the island’s famous black sand beaches and admire its breathtaking sunset views. Visit Fira, the island’s capital, known for its whitewashed houses, narrow streets, cliffside cafés, and stunning caldera views. Overnight in Santorini.

itinerary.title: Santorini to Athens ( By Ferry )
itinerary.text:
Breakfast and check-out from the hotel.
Free time at leisure until transfer to the port.
Depart by Seajet ferry to Athens. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel.
Evening at leisure. Overnight in Athens.

itinerary.title: Departure from Athens
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Athens Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 8 Day Athens, Santorini & Meteora Monasteries Tour?
faqs.a: The 8 Day Athens, Santorini & Meteora Monasteries Tour covers Athens, Santorini, Delphi, and Meteora. You will explore Athens' ancient landmarks, enjoy the spectacular beauty of Santorini, visit the archaeological site of Delphi, and discover the world-famous monasteries of Meteora perched atop dramatic rock formations. The tour runs for 7 nights and 8 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 8 Day Athens, Santorini & Meteora Monasteries Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,795 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, domestic speed ferry tickets, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees, selected meals, and all airport, hotel, and port transfers specified in the itinerary. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel availability.

faqs.q: Are transportation and ferry tickets included in this itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes domestic speed ferry transportation to Santorini as well as all required land transportation for the Delphi and Meteora excursions. These arrangements allow you to comfortably explore some of Greece's most famous cultural and natural attractions.

faqs.q: Are international flights included in the package?
faqs.a: No, international flights are not included in the tour price. Travelers are responsible for arranging their own flights to and from Greece. Magnificent Travel can assist with travel planning and recommendations if required.

faqs.q: Does the 8-day Greece tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise while ensuring a smooth and enjoyable travel experience throughout Greece.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Greece?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want to experience both Greece's famous islands and its cultural heritage. It combines Athens, Santorini, Delphi, and Meteora, offering an excellent balance of history, archaeology, scenery, and local culture.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic districts, and monastery complexes. Meteora includes some stair climbing and walking on uneven surfaces, but most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Delphi and Meteora?
faqs.a: Delphi is one of the most important archaeological sites in Greece and was once considered the center of the ancient world. Meteora is famous for its spectacular monasteries built on towering rock formations, offering breathtaking scenery and unique cultural experiences.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the Athens, Santorini & Meteora Monasteries Tour?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, ferry conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 8 Day Athens, Santorini & Meteora Monasteries Tour available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour operates throughout the year, subject to seasonal ferry schedules and monastery visiting hours. You can extend your stay in Athens or Santorini, upgrade hotel categories, add optional excursions, or modify the itinerary. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
